rows.text: takes `n` = `ecx` and a base from the low 12 bits of the result of the indirect call at `001E0B00` + 0x1A with `ecx` = 0: base 0x4749 when they are 0x40C, 0x47B1 when they are 0x407, else 0x46E1; returns base + `n` - 0x1C when `n` is at least 0x1C (signed), else `n` + 0x46DD when `n` is at least 1, else 0x46DC

when qword `02EBCC68` is non-null, passes it to the call at `003B7A30` + 0x12 and calls the site at `003B7A30` + 0x1F with that result and `edx` = 1; then walks the qwords from `02EBCAC0` at stride 8 while the index is below dword `02EBCBC0` (signed, re-read after each pair of calls) and, for each non-null qword, makes the same pair of calls at `003B7A30` + 0x48 and `003B7A30` + 0x55 (`edx` = 1)

walks the qwords from `02EBCA80` at stride 8 while the index is below dword `02EBCAA0` (signed, re-read each pass) and, with no null check, passes each to the call at `003B7AB0` + 0x23, then calls the site at `003B7AB0` + 0x30 with that result and `edx` = 1

notes: 001E0B00: the indirect call goes through qword 008C29B8, an import slot whose image value (0x1CCC826) the listing does not decode to a name, so the row cites only the site; 0x40C and 0x407 are not interpreted. 003B7A30: the count 02EBCBC0 is reloaded only after a non-null element's calls (at 003B7A8A); on a null element the previously loaded value is reused. 003B7A30 and 003B7AB0 call the same two callees in the same order, cited by site because the host excerpt does not name them.
